description: This file contains definitions for data structures and logic related to tracking and displaying Gateway usage data, including structs for usage windows, providers, summaries, and helper methods for formatting usage information in a macOS application.

classes.name: GatewayUsageWindow
classes.description: Represents a usage window with label, percentage used, and optional reset time.

classes.name: GatewayUsageProvider
classes.description: Represents a provider with associated usage windows, provider info, and optional plan or error messages.

classes.name: GatewayUsageSummary
classes.description: Contains a timestamp and a list of providers, representing a snapshot of all gateway usage data.

classes.name: UsageRow
classes.description: A view model struct for presenting usage data with computed properties for display purposes.

methods.name: primaryRows
methods.description: Generates a list of UsageRow objects representing primary usage data per provider.

methods.name: formatResetRemaining
methods.description: Formats the remaining reset time into a human-readable string.
